key_insight: ReMAQ enables sequential model averaging for generalized linear models by using quadratic approximation to avoid revisiting the full historical dataset.
engineering_relevance: The method supports computationally efficient prediction updates for high-volume streaming applications with multiple candidate models.
method: Approximate the GLM model-averaging objective with a quadratic formulation.
Update model-averaging weights through quadratic programming as each data batch arrives.
Establish asymptotic equivalence to full-data oracle weights and asymptotic optimality under regularity conditions.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports simulation studies and an Airline On-Time Performance Dataset application with favorable results, but provides no quantitative performance metrics.
watch_item: The theoretical guarantees require regularity conditions; robustness to distribution shifts in real-world streams is not established in the abstract.
paper_title: Renewable model averaging for generalized linear models
